Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — security review kickoff

Thanks again for taking the time today, John/Priya — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from Redwood to kick off the security & procurement track so we can keep the integration timeline intact.

Summary
- Goal: complete initial security intake and identify systems in scope for the security questionnaire and any PoC network review.
- Timeline target: intake + questionnaire completed by 11/12 so legal/procurement can start redlines the week of 11/16.

Immediate next steps (owners)
1) Magnify: confirm list of systems in scope (app, infra, data stores) — John / Priya — due 11/06
2) Redwood: send completed security questionnaire + network diagram template — Marissa — sent 11/03 (attached)
3) Technical sync (optional): SE deep-dive on data flows — Dev to coordinate if needed — proposed week of 11/09
4) Legal/procurement kickoff: connect Legal Ops to Redwood legal — Sean to introduce after intake complete

Attachments
- Magnify_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 92 KB) — initial intake for SOC2/security items
- network_diagram.pdf (pdf, 180 KB) — template for network boundaries and egress rules

A couple of clarifying questions from our side to help scope the questionnaire:
- Which environment(s) will Redwood access for the PoC? (prod, staging, or dedicated test cluster)
- Will there be PHI/PII in scope for the initial integration? If yes, we’ll escalate to our compliance team and include encryption/KMS details up front.

If that plan looks good, can you confirm the systems list by Friday 11/06? I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for a 30m technical sync (Dev + infra folks) for the week of 11/09.

Thanks — speak soon.

--
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — appreciated the clear plan. A few quick answers up front:
- Systems in scope (initial PoC): staging app cluster (staging01), a read-only replica of the patient metadata DB (analytics-db-readonly), and S3 buckets that will host model inputs (s3://magnify-dev-llm). Production is out of scope for the PoC.
- There will be limited PII in the sample dataset; not PHI. We sanitize identifiers but want to confirm encryption in transit and at rest.

We’ll review the questionnaire this morning and get back with the filled sections by Friday 11/06. Priya will be the primary on the questionnaire and legal ops will join when we surface contract items.

One ask: can Redwood share an ingress/egress network diagram for the expected flows so our infra team can do a quick firewall review?

John

Appreciate the speedy reply, John — that scope is perfect and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications on our side:

- Staging app cluster (staging01): Redwood will connect via TLS to the API endpoint you provide; we’ll only read and send back predictions, no writes.
- analytics-db-readonly: we only require read-only access to a narrow set of tables for feature extraction — access will be via a service account with least-privilege IAM roles.
- s3://magnify-dev-llm: we recommend a presigned-URL flow for object upload to avoid long-term credentials; all objects must be encrypted at rest using SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS.

We have attached a simple ingress/egress diagram template (network_diagram.pdf) in the original email; Dev and I can produce a Redwood-specific example if that’s helpful for your infra team.

Next actions I’ll take today:
- Send a short technical checklist for the SE sync so you can identify the right infra folks (Dev)
- Follow up with Sean to coordinate legal introduction once questionnaire is back

I’ll also propose two times for a 30m technical sync (11/10 at 10:00 PT or 11/11 at 11:00 PT) — please let me know which works or suggest alternatives.

Best,
Marissa

Hi John/Priya — quick technical note from the SE side.

Thanks for confirming scope — couple items to help your infra team prep before the sync:
- If you can confirm the CIDR ranges for staging01 and the egress NAT, we’ll pre-populate the firewall rules we typically request for the PoC.
- For the analytics-db-readonly connection we prefer TLS with certificate pinning where possible; if you use a managed read replica service, please include the connection string and any network peering details in the questionnaire.
- Regarding the S3 flow: presigned URLs are easiest. If you need server-side encryption with a KMS key you control, we can support MyKMS via role assumption — include the KMS ARN in the questionnaire.

I’ve also attached a simple example network diagram showing expected inbound/outbound ports — happy to tailor to your infra.

Proposed SE sync times (pick one):
- Tue 11/10 10:00 PT (30m)
- Wed 11/11 11:00 PT (30m)

Thanks —
